read_verilog sv2v_converted.v
chparam -set WIDTH 8 dut
hierarchy -libdir ./ -check -top dut
proc
logger -warn "parameter \\SYNTHESIS (0|[0-9]+'s?0+)[[:space:]]*$"
logger -werror "parameter \\SYNTHESIS (0|[0-9]+'s?0+)[[:space:]]*$"
tee -o effective_params_dut.il dump -n dut
synth -top dut -noabc -flatten
dfflibmap -liberty /opt/pdk/cell/lib/NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical_ccs.lib
tee -o ./log_abc_dut.txt abc -liberty /opt/pdk/cell/lib/NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical_ccs.lib -dont_use FA_X1 -dont_use HA_X1 -script +strash;ifraig;balance;rewrite;rewrite,-z;balance;refactor;balance;rewrite;map;print_stats
opt
select -assert-none =A:booley_check_library=1
read_liberty -lib -nooverwrite -setattr booley_check_library /opt/pdk/cell/lib/NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical_ccs.lib
tee -q -o ./check_dut.txt check
delete =A:booley_check_library=1
write_verilog ./synth_dut.v
setundef -zero
splitnets
clean
write_verilog -noattr -noexpr -nohex -nodec ./sta_dut.v
tee -o ./stat_dut.txt stat -liberty /opt/pdk/cell/lib/NangateOpenCellLibrary_typical_ccs.lib
